note: Textfield Counter provides five field widgets (string_textfield_with_counter/string, string_textarea_with_counter/string_long, text_textfield_with_counter/text, text_textarea_with_counter/text_long, text_textarea_with_summary_and_counter/text_with_summary) that show a live character counter and enforce a max length. No settings form (configure=null); configured per field on Manage form display and stored on the entity_form_display component: content.<field>.type + settings.{maxlength (0=disabled), counter_position before|after, js_prevent_submit, count_only_mode, count_html_characters, textcount_status_message, use_field_maxlength}. Server-side validation blocks over-limit submissions unless count_only_mode. Medium cases read back a known maxlength (140) and a known counter_position (before); hard cases switch a field from the core widget to the counter widget with a limit, and set a specific 100-char limit, verified against the live entity_form_display.

evals.prompt: I enabled the textfield_counter module but I can't find a settings page. How do I actually add a character counter to a Drupal text field, and what are the widget machine names it provides?
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page (configure=null). On the entity's Manage form display, choose the counter widget matching the field type: string_textfield_with_counter (string), string_textarea_with_counter (string_long), text_textfield_with_counter (text), text_textarea_with_counter (text_long), text_textarea_with_summary_and_counter (text_with_summary).

evals.prompt: For the textfield_counter widgets, which widget setting sets the character limit, and what happens if I set it to 0?
evals.expected_output: The maxlength widget setting sets the character limit. Setting maxlength to 0 disables the counter on that field. Textfield widgets can instead reuse the field's storage max-length via use_field_maxlength.

evals.prompt: Does the textfield_counter module actually stop a user from submitting text longer than the limit, or is the counter only visual? Which setting changes that behaviour?
evals.expected_output: By default it enforces the limit server-side (a form validation error blocks submission when over maxlength). Enabling count_only_mode makes the counter informational only (no validation). js_prevent_submit adds an extra client-side JS guard on top of server validation.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field field_tfc_known that uses a Textfield Counter widget. Inspect the live default form display and state the maximum character count configured for it.
evals.expected_output: field_tfc_known uses the text_textarea_with_counter widget with settings.maxlength = 140 in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a field field_tfc_pos using a Textfield Counter widget. Inspect the live default form display and state where the character counter is positioned relative to the input (before or after).
evals.expected_output: field_tfc_pos uses string_textarea_with_counter with settings.counter_position = 'before' (and maxlength 200), so the counter is shown before the input.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a formatted long-text field field_tfc_task that currently uses the standard textarea widget. Using the textfield_counter module, give this field a live character counter that limits it to 500 characters, and apply the change to the live default form display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_tfc_task component type to text_textarea_with_counter and settings.maxlength to 500 (any value >= 1). The verify checks the widget is text_textarea_with_counter with maxlength >= 1.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article field field_tfc_limit already uses a Textfield Counter widget, but the counter is currently disabled (no limit). Configure it to limit entries to exactly 100 characters, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_tfc_limit component's settings.maxlength to 100 (keeping widget string_textfield_with_counter). The verify checks maxlength === 100.
